answer: Make every identity mint fresh, non-duplicable reasoning each epoch, and have the ledger score semantic entropy to reject near-copies before any peer attests. A clone farm cannot stamp one polished reply across a thousand keys like saffron pressed from identical copper molds—each head must independently think or earn zero weight. So a Sybil spinning 1000 fakes pays 1000x the real compute and novel-cognition cost per round, with no shared oasis of cached answers to amortize; on-ledger duplicate detection catches the reuse and grants the clones nothing.
